body: chalk numbers run across the fire extinguisher and camera. the count skips one place, then resumes in a different hand.
title: missing count beside the fire extinguisher

body: Diary line at the first trap: a torn pasture-test tag was caught beneath the spring. Its number belongs to a drum the return ledger calls sealed.
title: First trap held a torn field tag

body: Camp log: the pasture-study team slept here for three nights. On the fourth morning their cook poured out the water because it smelled medicinal.
title: Camp used by the pasture team

body: Field diary: the first north arrow leads past drums used to wash pasture-test gear. One drum was already sealed when the checkpoint crew arrived.
title: North arrow past the wash drums

body: Photograph back: the second trap contained a torn soil-sample bag, not an animal. Blue granules beneath it matched the coating on the trial seed.
title: Second trap held a sample bag

body: Personal note from the checkpoint: wave through the green field badges before recording civilian plates. I copied one badge number after its wearer began shaking.
title: Checkpoint checked field badges

body: Road-crew receipt: barriers were moved downhill after a trial drum leaked. The billed time is two hours before the radio announced an emergency route.
title: Barriers moved after the spill

body: Torn page: follow the upper north arrow to the trial gate and count every rinse can. The crew counted seven going in and six coming back.
title: Upper arrow toward the trial gate
